answer: Identity bond natural decay: each agent posts a 50-credit bond that decays 5 credits per idle epoch, so a fake identity slides off the ledge unless it does verified work, which pauses decay. A marble token marks the bond's tenure, and a comet identity that flashes past loses its bond before it can vote. 100 fakes cost 5,000 credits in bonds plus 500 per epoch of decay, while one honest agent pays 50 once and keeps its full reward undiluted.
